# Win Loss Analysis

`win-loss-analysis` · v1.1.0 · Diagnose · Sales & Pipeline
<!-- Generated by platform/scripts/generate-engine-specs.mjs from skills/win-loss-analysis/spec.json and SKILL.md. Do not edit. -->

**Decision it supports:** Which loss reasons, segments and competitors cost us the most revenue, and where should the fix start?

**Inputs:** A list of recent closed deals (won and lost) with outcome, segment, competitor, and any reason notes.

**Output:** A win-loss summary — ranked win/loss reasons, patterns by segment and competitor, no-decision rate, and prioritized fixes.

**Setup:**
- Install the skill: `npx skills add sarojkjha/aaj-marketing-skills --skill win-loss-analysis`
- Or connect the hosted MCP server, no install: `https://aaj-engines-mcp.sarojkjha10.workers.dev/mcp`
- Or run the local MCP server: node platform/mcp/server.mjs (Node 18 or newer)
- Input schema: the comment at the top of `skills/win-loss-analysis/resources/win-loss.js` (the MCP server's describe_engine shows it). Worked example: `node skills/win-loss-analysis/resources/win-loss.js --demo`.
- Agents listed: Claude Code, Cursor, OpenAI Codex, Windsurf, Cline. Tested and recorded: Claude Code.

**Acts or analyzes:** Analyzes only. The engine makes no network calls, writes no files and changes nothing in your tools; it returns text and JSON.

**Where your information goes:**

| How you run it | Where your inputs go |
|---|---|
| Skill installed in your agent, or the local MCP server | The engine runs on your machine and AAJ receives nothing. Your AI agent still sends what you give it to its model provider (Anthropic, OpenAI and so on), under your own account's terms. |
| Hosted MCP server | Your agent's model provider, as above, plus AAJ's server on Cloudflare, which receives the engine inputs over HTTPS, runs them in memory and keeps no copy. Cloudflare keeps error logs (no inputs) for up to 7 days. |

No engine needs customer names, emails or other personal data; leave them out.

**Limitations:**
- Input it doesn't recognise returns the worked example rather than an error; check the result reflects your data. From the command line it prints the demo even for valid deals.
- It computes rates and revenue concentration only. It does not read win reasons, interview notes or the stage a deal was lost at; that work stays with the skill.
- The 'biggest fixable leak' is simply the segment and loss reason with the most lost revenue, even no decision or missing feature. Decide yourself whether it is fixable.
- It does not flag thin samples. A reason with one or two deals can top the list; check the count beside each before calling it a pattern.

**Review before acting:** The sales lead confirms loss reasons are coded from deal evidence into a consistent set and that each top pattern rests on enough deals, before a fix is assigned to product, marketing or sales.

Method: [skills.aajconsult.com/skills/win-loss-analysis](https://skills.aajconsult.com/skills/win-loss-analysis)
